briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as unemployment steadies and core inflation edges toward the Fed's target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 is cooling toward the Fed's target, easing pressure on rates.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 holds firm, anchoring household demand and income.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury higher, from 4.99 percent to 5.05 percent.
